description: This file defines the 'Home' page component for a furniture shopping web app. It sets up the layout for displaying products in a grid, handles loading/error states, and manages modal visibility. It imports local components (Header, ProductCard, FloatingCartButton, CheckoutModal) and external dependencies (Blits, theme, AppStore).

classes.name: Component (from Blits)
classes.description: A Blits framework component representing the Home page with internal state, subscriptions, and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Defines reactive state variables for layout, messages, and modal visibility.

methods.name: watchers
methods.description: Watches for width and height changes to update content dimensions.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Subscribes to AppStore to update product layout, loading/error messages, and modal state.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes component dimensions and loads products if necessary.
